title: Simulating solid electrolyte interphase formation spanning 108 time scales with an atomically informed phase-field model
content:

The solid electrolyte interphase (SEI), formed by electrolyte reduction, governs the reversibility of batteries, however the competition between Li-ion diffusion and reaction kinetics remains poorly understood.
